item.title: Episode 678: My Lai Massacre Part III - Murder Dressed Up as Victory
item.description:
The road to My Lai enters its final stretch as the Tet Offensive leaves the American military desperate for a win and willing to count any Vietnamese body as Viet Cong. Along the way, the boys get into Project 100,000, Task Force Barker, “Mad Dog” Medina, and the dangerously incompetent Lieutenant William Calley before Charlie Company prepares to march into My Lai.

item.title: Episode 677: My Lai Massacre Part II - Ain’t No Daylight in Vietnam
item.description:
This week, the march toward My Lai continues as America sinks deeper into Vietnam, from JFK and the Gulf of Tonkin to LBJ’s escalation of the war, the rise of body counts, and the growing brutality that helped create the conditions for a massacre... As LBJ himself put it, "there ain’t no daylight in Vietnam".

item.title: Episode 676: My Lai Massacre Part I - Ho Money Ho Problems
item.description:
The boys are back as Marcus leads Henry and Ed into the first chapter of our My Lai Massacre series, tracing the long and bloody road that brought America into Vietnam. From French colonial rule and the rise of Ho Chi Minh to guerrilla warfare, Cold War paranoia, and one catastrophic decision after another, the boys break down how America stumbled into a war it never understood and could never win.

item.title: Episode 675: Breatharianism
item.description:

item.title: Pinocchio Unstrung: An Interview with Robert Englund - Last Interview on the Left
item.description:
This week on Last Interview on the Left, Henry and Ed welcome horror legend Robert Englund to the show to celebrate Pinocchio: Unstrung. The gang talks horror's next generation, practical effects, Freddy's legacy, killer puppets, the movies that still impress Robert, and why he's still chasing projects that surprise him. Plus, behind-the-scenes stories from Pinocchio: Unstrung, as well as a few unexpected movie recommendations from one of horror's all-time greats. Pinocchio: Unstrung in Theaters July 24th and VOD soon!

For Live Shows, Merch, and More Visit: www.LastPodcastOnTheLeft.com
